columns.name: ID
columns.description: Unique ID which is used as a primary key

columns.name: ESS_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Indicates Unique identifier of the ess request identifier

columns.name: JOBNAME
columns.description: To distinguish the records based on jobname

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning. Foreign key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.

columns.name: STARTTIME
columns.description: Indicates the date and time the transaction ESS job began executing.

columns.name: ENDTIME
columns.description: Indicates the date and time the transaction ESS job finished executing.

columns.name: TRANSACTIONSPICKED
columns.description: Indicates the transactions handled by the the transaction ESS job.

columns.name: TRANSACTIONSUPDATED
columns.description: Indicates the transactions updated by the the transaction ESS job.

columns.name: LOGS
columns.description: Log files associated with the transaction ESS job run.

columns.name: SUBMITTEDFROM
columns.description: Indicates whether ESS job was run from the ESS Scheduler or manually from the Transaction Console application.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of the transaction ESS job.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
